title: target-gate-result/v2 — the target RVA's machine-readable gate result (architecture §5.4, §7.1; design §8.1 / T0)

verdict.description: the governing verdict; must be consistent with the category

category.description: stable routing category; the orchestrator never upgrades an exit code or parses prose

resolved_range.description: the exact base..sha the gate judged, both full

manifest.description: target-repo-relative manifest path the gate ran against

tree_digest.description: git tree object id of the judged SHA

evidence_digests.description: sha256 digests of the evidence files the gate produced

gate_version.description: version of the target gate implementation that produced this result

allOf.$comment: verdict PASS if and only if the category is an accepting one
